notes: User is planning their week and wants help with productivity, organization, scheduling, and prioritization (S1.U1). They use Todoist and are considering making it central to their routine; they are also interested in Trello, especially Google Calendar integrations, progress/goal tracking, and managing multiple projects (S1.U2–S1.U5). They usually go to the gym on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, originally at 7:00 pm (S1.U3; superseded: gym time stated as 6:00 pm in S2.U3, apparently when heading after the client meeting). For a potential-client meeting, they are generally flexible but prefer Tuesday or Thursday (S2.U2). They chose Tuesday at 2:00 pm so there is time to finish before the gym (S2.U3). Before the meeting, they will create a Google Drive folder containing the necessary files and email the client a shared link with a brief note (S2.U5). They plan to confirm the meeting’s date and time—Tuesday at 2:00 pm—in that email (S2.U6).
